Description: As a Cloud Security Engineer, I want to establish a secure multi-cloud foundation so that USCG can deploy compliant workloads across regions.
Acceptance Criteria: All child stories completed,Security controls verified,Documentation updated

Description: As a Cloud Administrator, I want to establish a hierarchical AWS GovCloud account structure so that I can enforce security controls and billing management across all USCG workloads
Acceptance Criteria: Master payer account configured,Organizational units aligned with regions,SCPs implemented for each OU,Guardrails enforced across accounts

Description: As a Cloud Administrator, I want to configure Azure Government tenant with proper hierarchy so that I can manage access control and resource organization effectively
Acceptance Criteria: Management groups structured by region,RBAC hierarchy implemented,Subscription model defined,Policy assignments configured

Description: As a Security Engineer, I want to implement cross-cloud identity federation so that users can access multiple cloud platforms securely with single sign-on
Acceptance Criteria: AWS SSO configured,Azure AD synchronization established,Cross-cloud trust relationships verified,MFA enforced across platforms

Description: As a Security Engineer, I want to implement comprehensive security controls so that all cloud resources meet FedRAMP High requirements
Acceptance Criteria: All security controls implemented,FedRAMP requirements met,Documentation complete

Description: As a Security Analyst, I want to implement centralized logging across cloud platforms so that I can monitor and investigate security events effectively
Acceptance Criteria: CloudWatch logs configured,Azure Monitor implemented,Cross-cloud log aggregation working,Log retention policies enforced

Description: As a Security Engineer, I want to implement a unified key management system so that encryption keys are securely managed across all cloud platforms

Description: As a Network Engineer, I want to establish a resilient multi-cloud network backbone so that all USCG locations can communicate securely
